layer.statement: observed OpenBuildingMap footprints (Microsoft ML and OpenStreetMap) plus synthetic buildings where the GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface shows unmapped building area (data-build/build_footprint_completeness.py); replaceable by any layer with the same schema

M7.description: Reinforced or confined masonry with RC floors

RC3-M.description: RC dual system (frame + wall) — moderate code (ERD-M)

RC3-H.description: RC dual system (frame + wall) — high code (ERD-H)

RC5-L.description: RC precast frame — no / low code (ERD-L)

RC6-L.description: RC precast wall or dual system — no / low code (ERD-L)

RC6-M.description: RC precast wall or dual system — moderate code (ERD-M)

S-M/H.description: Steel frame — moderate or high code (ERD-M or ERD-H)

T2-L.description: Timber frame or wall — no / low code (ERD-L)

T2-M/H.description: Timber frame or wall — moderate or high code (ERD-M or ERD-H)
